faqSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqSection.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Struxa before you get started.

questions.question: What is Struxa?
questions.answer: Struxa is an open-source game server management panel built as a modern replacement for Pterodactyl. It lets you create, manage, and monitor game servers through a clean web interface.

questions.question: Is Struxa really free?
questions.answer: Yes. Struxa is fully open-source and free to self-host. There are no licensing fees. Struxa Cloud — a fully managed hosted version — is coming soon.

questions.question: How is Struxa different from Pterodactyl?
questions.answer: Struxa is a clean-room implementation built with a modern TypeScript stack (Next.js, oRPC, Drizzle ORM). It is actively maintained, has a dark operator-focused UI, and is designed for developer contribution.

questions.question: What game servers does Struxa support?
questions.answer: Struxa supports any game server that can run via Wings-compatible eggs — including Minecraft, Counter-Strike 2, Valheim, ARK: Survival Evolved, Rust, and more.

questions.question: How do I get started?
questions.answer: Clone the repository and follow the setup guide at docs.struxa.cloud. You'll need a server running the Wings daemon and a database to get started.

questions.question: What is Struxa Cloud?
questions.answer: Struxa Cloud hosts the panel for you — no need to self-host the panel itself. You still bring your own Wings nodes and game servers. Automatic updates, priority support. Coming soon.

faqSection.contactDescription: Reach out via email or open an issue on GitHub — we're happy to help.
